hero.headline: Building the 3MW AI Backbone
hero.subheadline: Phase 3 is where we transition from a regional leader to a continental power player, leveraging hyperscale logic on Kenyan energy.

sections.title: From Modular Pilot to Continental Hub
sections.body: Phase 3 represents the full-scale industrialization of our model. Having perfected the modular deployment in Phases 1 and 2, we will expand our primary site to its full 3MW+ IT load capacity. This stage moves beyond containerized units into custom-engineered data center halls, optimized for the next decade of AI progress. We are designing Phase 3 to be 'Liquid Ready,' anticipating the arrival of ultra-high TDP chips from NVIDIA and AMD that will require direct-to-chip or immersion cooling as standard. This hyperscale approach will allow us to capture the largest enterprise training contracts in the EMEA region, providing a scale of compute previously only available in the US or Europe. By this stage, Kenya AI Compute will serve as the anchor tenant of a new technology park in Kenya, fostering a local ecosystem of AI development and research. sections.title: Phase 3 Expansion Goals
items: Power Scaling: Increasing total site IT load to 3.0 MW and beyond.
Custom Infrastructure: Construction of high-efficiency, permanent data center halls.
Next-Gen Cooling: Deployment of industrial liquid cooling loops for 60kW+ racks.
Regional Peering: Establishing direct fiber interconnects with neighboring tech hubs (Addis Ababa, Kigali).
Institutional Exit: Reaching the operational scale required for a major strategic sale or IPO.

Our vision for 2028: High-performance computing for a whole continent.
